Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D frame-by-frame enemy animation sprite sheet for a portrait sci-fi tower defense game.
Input image: identity and rendering-style reference ONLY. Repaint the same creature in twelve distinct animation poses.
Subject: small six-legged crawler beetle. Preserve: rounded split ivory shell, dark navy hexagonal armor, orange dorsal crystal, two ivory curved front pincers. Keep the exact navy / ivory / orange / cyan or green palette of the reference, same limb count, same identity, crisp Japanese sci-fi game illustration with bold readable silhouette, facing the same down-screen frontal or slight three-quarter direction in ALL frames.
Output ONE landscape sprite sheet with EXACTLY 12 separately drawn complete creatures, arranged in a precise 4-COLUMN by 3-ROW regular grid. Suggested canvas 1536 x 1024. No text, labels, borders or drawn grid. Each cell contains ONE whole creature at identical scale and camera, centered at the same local anchor, generous blank gaps and 15% padding, no limb or tail crosses a cell boundary. No duplicates pasted unchanged. Every moving pose must change actual limb joint positions, not merely translate, rotate, tint or resize the whole creature.
Frame sequence, row-major:
ROW 1: [0 idle relaxed] [1 idle breathing with visibly adjusted pincers/tendrils/armor] [2 locomotion phase 1] [3 locomotion phase 2].
ROW 2: [4 locomotion phase 3] [5 locomotion phase 4] [6 locomotion phase 5] [7 locomotion phase 6, leading naturally back to phase 1].
ROW 3: [8 attack anticipation, raise pincers] [9 attack release, snap them forward] [10 charging posture, appendages gathered and armor partially opened, core slightly brighter] [11 charging posture advanced, armor further opened and core brighter].
Locomotion requirements: alternate the left and right tripod leg groups, visibly bend and lift individual knees, opening and closing front pincers. Make the six locomotion silhouettes clearly distinguishable even at a small gameplay size. Idle, movement, attacking and charging are all actual painted poses. Base body stays anchored; articulate appendages and small weight shifts. No ground, no shadows outside the creature, no external projectiles, no large bloom.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha if available. If alpha cannot be returned, use perfectly uniform pure magenta #FF00FF as a chroma-key backing; never draw checkerboards, gradients or scenery. The creature itself must contain no magenta pixels.
